title: Backend Python Developer
description:
Job Title: Backend Python Developer
  
  
Location: Bangalore
  
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
  
Experience Required: 5 – 7 years (Mid-Level)
  
  
**About VectorStack**
VectorStack is a tech-innovation company driving digital transformation and business performance through cloud, AI/ML, software development, and consulting. We partner with clients across Retail, FinTech, EdTech, AdTech, and more to build scalable, secure, and future-ready technology stacks.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Architect, build, and maintain backend services, APIs, and microservices using Python (Flask / FastAPI).
  
  
Design and optimize CRUD operations across relational and non-relational databases (MongoDB, SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL).
  
  
Model and maintain data schemas, indexes, constraints, and relationships.
  
  
Ensure robust error handling, logging, and API validation.
  
  
Optimize backend endpoints for performance, scalability, and latency.
  
  
Integrate services with authentication, rate limiting, caching, and versioning.
  
  
Deploy, manage, and monitor backend services on AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch).
  
  
Write unit tests, integration tests, and conduct code reviews.
  
  
Maintain API specs, data models, and architecture documentation.
  
  
Collaborate with frontend, DevOps, QA, and product teams for end-to-end delivery.
  
  
Stay updated with technology trends and mentor junior engineers.
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
4–6 years of backend software development experience.
  
  
Strong proficiency in Python with hands-on experience in RESTful APIs and microservices.
  
  
Proficiency with Flask and FastAPI frameworks.
  
  
Strong database knowledge: MongoDB and at least one relational DB (PostgreSQL/MySQL).
  
  
Deep understanding of CRUD operations, data modeling, and query optimization.
  
  
Experience deploying and managing services on AWS.
  
  
Familiarity with Docker and containerization.
  
  
Understanding of concurrency and asynchronous programming (asyncio, background tasks).
  
  
Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance tuning skills.
  
  
Solid experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and coding best practices.
  
  
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  
  
**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**
Kubernetes / container orchestration.
  
  
Messaging and streaming systems (RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  
  
Caching systems (Redis, Memcached).
  
  
Authentication/authorization frameworks (JWT, OAuth2).
  
  
Experience with event-driven architectures.
  
  
Domain experience in e-commerce, fintech, or SaaS platforms.
  
  
Logs and monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack).
  
  
Why Join VectorStack?
  
  
Be part of a core engineering team solving real-world, large-scale problems.
  
  
Work on cutting-edge cloud and AI/ML-powered solutions.
  
  
Collaborative, growth-oriented environment.
  
  
Competitive compensation and opportunities for career advancement

**#GenerationCGI**
, you’ll join a community of graduates who are turning ambition into action and possibility into progress.
  
  
As a
**Technology Engineer - Software, Cloud & Infrastructure Graduate**

You’ll be trusted with responsibility from the start, working alongside experienced colleagues on live projects across a range of industries. You’ll develop broad technical experience while building deeper expertise in the technologies and areas that best match your strengths and career ambitions.
  
  
**Your Future Duties And Responsibilities**
In this role, you’ll use technology to solve real-world problems and deliver reliable services for CGI’s clients. The work will vary by project, giving you opportunities to develop experience across software engineering, testing, cloud technology, infrastructure, DevOps and technical support.
  
  
**You May**

* Develop software solutions: Design, build and maintain front-end, back-end or full-stack applications using modern programming languages, frameworks and development practices.
* Test and assure quality: Create and run manual or automated tests to help ensure that software is reliable, secure and meets user requirements.
* Engineer cloud platforms: Help design, configure and support scalable cloud environments using technologies such as AWS or Microsoft Azure.
* Build and support infrastructure: Work with operating systems, networks, virtualisation, containers and platform services that underpin critical applications.
* Automate delivery: Apply DevOps and DevSecOps practices to improve build, testing, deployment and operational processes.
* Support live services: Investigate technical issues, monitor systems and help maintain the performance, availability and security of applications and platforms.
* Work with data and emerging technology: Contribute to projects involving data engineering, artificial intelligence, automation or other developing technologies.
* Collaborate with clients and colleagues: Work in multidisciplinary teams, communicate technical information clearly and help deliver solutions that meet client needs.
* Innovate alongside other graduates: Take part in early careers initiatives that go beyond your day-to-day role.

Every contribution you make will help deliver outcomes with lasting impact.
  
  
Locations
  
  
Opportunities are available in
**Aberdeen, Belfast, Bridgend, Bristol, Cardiff, Chippenham, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Gloucester, Leatherhead, Leeds, London, Manchester, Milton Keynes, Newcastle, Nottingham, Reading, the Scottish Borders and Sheffield**
.As CGI is a consultancy, you may be required to work from a CGI office or client site and occasionally travel to different locations. Flexibility and a willingness to travel are therefore important.
  
  
Why Join Us?
  
  
At CGI, you’ll be part of a culture that celebrates diversity, inclusion and collaboration, where your perspective is valued and your ideas contribute to meaningful outcomes.Your journey starts with a structured Early Careers Induction Programme, giving you the foundations to succeed, along with 24/7 e-learning and opportunities to gain professional certifications that build your expertise. You’ll also join our Student Kick-start Initiative, where you’ll collaborate with other graduates on creative projects that deliver impact beyond your day-to-day role.CGI is an unconditionally inclusive workplace where you are respected, your voice is heard and you can be yourself. We were recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and named a UK ‘Best Employer’ by the Financial Times. We proudly hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant.
  
  
**Benefits**
Along with a competitive salary and a £1,000 joining bonus, you’ll enjoy benefits that support every stage of your journey. You’ll share in CGI’s success through our matched share scheme, have access to private healthcare, well-being programmes and professional training, and build financial security with a competitive pension. Beyond the day job, you’ll connect with others through graduate networks, diversity groups and social clubs that make your time at CGI both rewarding and enjoyable.
  
  
**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
We’re seeking technically curious graduates who enjoy solving problems and want to build technology that makes a real difference. You do not need experience in every area listed below. We’re interested in the technical strengths you already have, your willingness to learn and the direction in which you want to develop.
  
  
**You Should Have**

* A minimum 2:2 degree, normally in computer science, software engineering, information technology, computer engineering, mathematics, physics, cyber security or another relevant STEM subject. Some positions may accept other degree subjects where you can demonstrate strong technical ability, and some may require a 2:1.
* A genuine interest in software, cloud technology, infrastructure or supporting technical services.
* Strong analytical thinking and a practical approach to solving problems.
* The ability to work collaboratively and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.
* Attention to detail and a commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality work.
* A willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to different projects and client environments.
* Flexibility to travel and work from CGI offices or client sites where required.
* Eligibility for Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) clearance, with some positions requiring higher National Security Vetting. This may include additional residency or nationality requirements, which will be explained for the relevant role.

**Technical Skills We Value Include**

* Programming and scripting: Experience with one or more languages such as Java, C#, Python or JavaScript.
* Software engineering: An understanding of application development, full-stack development, APIs, microservices, web or mobile development.
* Software testing: An interest in quality assurance, test automation and building reliable software.
* Cloud technologies: Exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure, cloud architecture or cloud-native development.
* DevOps and automation: Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible or related automation and delivery tools.
* Containers and platforms: An understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, virtualisation or platform engineering.
* Systems and infrastructure: Familiarity with Linux or Red Hat, systems administration, networking, infrastructure engineering or site reliability engineering.
* Data technologies: Exposure to SQL, data engineering, Databricks, Elastic or data modelling.
* Agile delivery: An understanding of Agile ways of working and tools such as Jira or Confluence.
* Emerging technology: An interest in artificial intelligence, generative AI, automation or other developing technologies would be beneficial.

**What You Can Expect From Us**
**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  
  
That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
  
  
Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

Company Description

AIHealthOps builds AI agents that help medical practices, clinics, and healthcare organizations spend less time on paperwork. Our agents support administrative workflows across specialties, including patient intake, scheduling, routine inquiries, document processing, eligibility verification, prior authorization, referral coordination, denial appeal preparation, and task tracking.

We configure and test each implementation around the organization’s existing workflows. Staff review sensitive submissions, and qualified healthcare professionals make clinical decisions.

Role Description

As a Software Developer at AIHealthOps, you’ll build secure, reliable Python services and AI-powered workflows for healthcare operations. You’ll work with product and operations teams to turn workflow requirements into software that clinic staff can use.

* Design, build, and maintain Python backend services, REST APIs, and third-party integrations.
* Improve data processing pipelines and troubleshoot production issues.
* Write maintainable, testable code and contribute to automated testing, code reviews, and documentation.
* Help make architecture decisions that improve performance, reliability, and scalability.

Qualifications

* **2+ years of professional software development experience**
  , including hands-on experience building applications in Python.
* Experience with backend development, REST APIs, relational databases, and third-party integrations.
* A foundation in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and software design.
* Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and communicate clearly with a remote, cross-functional team.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

* Familiarity with Docker or a cloud platform such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.
* Experience with or interest in healthcare software, health information systems, or workflow automation.
